sources.title: Minigames - Official Soul's Remnant Wiki
sources.author: wiki (not named)
sources.why: Official fan wiki already in the project. Not fetched (site is blocked and already known); claims below are taken from search-result summaries, so they are paraphrases, not verbatim. Useful for minigame unlock levels and controls. No numbers on EXP or drop rates.

claims.claim: Minigames are designed around Gathering life skills. All party members must have the matching Gathering skill unlocked to enter.
claims.quote_original: (paraphrase of search summary; no verbatim quote retrieved)

claims.claim: Kmitty's Food Stall uses Fishing and unlocks through a level 15 quest named Kmitty's Big Dream.
Shepherd's Pet Problem uses Herbalism and unlocks through a level 20 quest.
Barrier Forge uses Mining and unlocks through a level 20 quest named The Fraying Barrier.
Minigames are timed, need a party of 2 to 6, and the wiki recommends practicing the skill once or twice first.
Mining and Herbalism: purple arrows mean press the opposite input; faded arrows mean skip that input. Fishing: wiki advises never holding a movement key longer than one second.
Nature's Veil cannot be used once you have entered a minigame.

sources.title: Soul's Remnant: How to respec skills and free up skill points
sources.author: AllThingsHow Staff (no individual named)
sources.why: Staff byline, no named player. Only numeric example is a hypothetical (5 SP). Formulaic SEO wording and repeated promo blocks, and no tested specifics such as costs or menu quirks. Mechanics described are plausible but untested in the article.

claims.claim: Skills are unlocked with Dull Life Essences once each skill's unlock conditions are met, not with Skill Points.

Skill Points set the total combined skill level you can run across active skills. Example given (hypothetical): with 5 SP you can raise one skill to level 5, and the article says the first level of a basic skill costs no point, so the pool reaches level 6.
Lowering a skill's level through Manage Level returns SP to the pool. Dragging a skill out of the Skill menu frees all the SP it used.
Unlocking a skill is permanent. Dull Life Essences and materials spent on it cannot be recovered.
Inactive skills and archetypes gain no EXP. Each character level grants one Skill Point plus attribute points. Quests are described as the fastest route to EXP; the / key shows active quests.

sources.author: not named; credited to 'Soul's Remnant Wiki' (fan-made site)
sources.why: No author. Generic, templated text with almost no numbers. Repeatedly says 'To be confirmed' or 'We are verifying', and uses vague hedges ('may boost CON') with no magnitudes. Lists 4 of 8 professions as confirmed and says 700+ recipes. Not a player-written guide.

claims.claim: The guide says there are eight crafting professions and 700+ recipes; only Blacksmith, Armorsmith, Alchemy and Weapon Smithing are listed, the rest marked 'To be confirmed'.
Crafting uses a card minigame where higher skill levels give better cards. No thresholds given.
Fishing needs no pickaxe; some rare fish appear only in specific locations. No levels or spot numbers.
